we propose a new class of models that aggregate prior states to improve sample efficiency and robustness to noisy inputs.
we propose AMRL to learn better policies with better sample efficiency and that our models are resilient to noisy input.

the problem of learning to navigate complex environments using long-term memory.
how to improve RL by leveraging memory.
